note: Style references sent with every thumbnail prompt, in this order, as Fish 'ref' inputs. object_key is the Fish upload (re-upload with create_media_upload if Fish reports it missing).

refs.label: PAUSED. close-up
refs.about: PAUSED. — extreme close-up of the mascot's smug half-lidded face, finger pressing a glowing pause button toward the viewer. Reference for face design, rim light, close-up framing and the single giant yellow word.

refs.label: split face, mascot half only
refs.about: Split face — left half is the mascot, right half is a human. Use ONLY the mascot half: head shading, glossy highlights, violet rim, eye and grin shapes, hoodie folds. Do not copy the human half or put a human face in the thumbnail unless the scene asks for one. No text in this reference.

refs.label: TOO SLOW. action shot
refs.about: TOO SLOW. — full-body action shot: the mascot sprinting past a car on a night street with afterimages and speed streaks. Reference for full-body proportions, action posing, motion effects, background depth and the two-line white-over-yellow lettering.
